generated_draft.name: Desert Rookie 3v3
generated_draft.description: Join us for the Desert Rookie 3v3 basketball tournament in Phoenix, where new talent shines! This exciting event is designed for beginner players looking to showcase their skills on the court. Team up with friends, make new ones, and compete in a fun and supportive environment. Come out and enjoy a day filled with basketball, community spirit, and friendly competition!
rules: Teams consist of 3 players each with a maximum of 12 teams participating.
Games are played to 15 points, and you must win by 2.
Each game has a 10-minute time limit; the team with the most points at the end wins.
Out-of-bounds and fouls will be called by the referees; sportsmanship is encouraged at all times.
No dunking allowed during the tournament for safety reasons.
Players must arrive 15 minutes prior to their scheduled game to check-in.
